articles.title: Moderna’s Cancer Vaccine Breakthrough: What It Means for the Stock
articles.excerpt:
Moderna and Merck’s personalised mRNA cancer vaccine has delivered positive results in a late-stage trial for melanoma, marking a major milestone for the technology beyond COVID-19 vaccines. The development sent Moderna shares sharply higher as investors reassessed the company’s long-term growth prospects. (Sources: CNBC, Reuters, Yahoo Finance)

The Phase 3 INTerpath-001 trial tested intismeran autogene, Moderna’s personalised mRNA cancer vaccine, in combination with Merck’s blockbuster immunotherapy Keytruda. The treatment met its main goal of improving recurrence-free survival and also achieved a key secondary goal involving distant metastasis-free survival.

articles.title: Moderna’s 177% Surge Burns Shorts in ‘Painful’ $5.5 Billion Loss
articles.excerpt:
A record surge in Moderna Inc.’s shares delivered a $5.5 billion blow to short sellers who had bet that the vaccine maker’s years-long slump would continue.

Moderna’s stock price soared 177% on Wednesday after the company said its personalized cancer vaccine developed with partner Merck & Co. helped reduce the recurrence of melanoma in a late-stage trial. The jump generated paper losses of about $5.5 billion for short sellers, bringing mark-to-market losses to roughly $7.7 billion this year, according to data from S3 Partners LLC.

articles.excerpt:
Aditya Birla Capital Ltd (ABCL) has entered the Gold Loan business, marking a strategic expansion of its secured lending portfolio. The diversified financial services company plans for a phase-wise rollout of 200-300 dedicated Gold Loan branches by March 2027 across high-potential markets.

Over the next three years, the ABCL-Non Banking Finance Company business aims to establish a network of around 1,000 Gold Loan branches.

articles.title: Euro zone bonds join global selloff, long-end yields at multi-year highs
articles.excerpt:
